name: Whisper Memos
description: Official server for the Whisper Memos iPhone and Apple Watch voice memo app: list and read memo transcripts and summaries, list labels, view account details, and delete memos; it cannot create or edit memos. OAuth 2.1, approved in the iOS app. Endpoint: `https://whispermemos.com/mcp` · [Config](https://github.com/whispermemos/whisper-memos-plugin) · Registry: `com.whispermemos/whisper-memos`
